<!-- nativecmpkit-progress:d849515b:displayed-month -->

Programmatic selection/month ownership repair at `d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f`.

The preserved simulator failure is **after** selecting March16 while April is displayed (`NativeDateControlsTest`, line55), not initial April creation. `CalendarViewHost.preservingVisibleMonth` captures the actual native visible month, suppresses transient owner-navigation reports, and restores it around nonanimated `CalendarDatePickerBackend.setSelectedDate`. Regression assertions retain selection/null and no-spurious-month-callback requirements.

[Checkpoint](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f/docs/development/checkpoint-ci-20261026.md). The repaired native regression has **not yet executed**; this source change does not close the issue. Legacy save/restore and compact/wheels/inline acceptance stay required.
